purpose: Test explicit negation on development data only, comparing zero-shot and fine-tuned NLI

hypotheses.neg_gap: This is not a research gap.

split: Existing 17-paper stratified validation half A chooses thresholds; 17-paper half B compares frozen thresholds; both halves were examined in prior work

methods.positive: max over types of E_positive / (E_positive + C_positive)
methods.negative: max over types of C_negative / (E_negative + C_negative)
methods.mean: max over types of the mean of the positive and negative scores
methods.either: max over types of the larger of positive and negative scores
methods.both: max over types of the smaller of positive and negative scores

threshold_rule: For each score on half A, highest observed threshold retaining at least 80%, 90%, or 95% of all A positives including cleanup losses; thresholds fixed before B metrics
scoring: Stage A junk filter then sentence alone; pair tokenization max 256, only sentence truncated; softmax E/N/C; epsilon 1e-9
